chunks: Ibn Abi Umayr from Abdullah ibn Sinan from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said:
I heard him saying: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'Raise your voices with the blessings upon me, for it removes hypocrisy.'
ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual benefit of raising one's voice in Salawat according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this narration from al-Kafi, the Prophet Muhammad (saww) links the public or audible recitation of Salawat to the eradication of Nifaq (hypocrisy), a concept deeply explored in Shia exegesis as the concealment of faith in the heart. This practice serves as a tangible manifestation of sincerity, aligning the believer's outward speech with their inner conviction, thereby purifying the soul from the duality of the hypocrite. The emphasis on raising voices reflects the communal and declarative nature of devotion in early Islamic tradition.
